reviews.text: Been going here for years, very nice work and the groomers are super sweet!

This place is awful. I took my little dog there on Friday to get her hair and nails trimmed, and they told me to come back in two hours. After the time had passed, a woman came out and told me my dog ​​was "spoiled" 😡. When they handed her back to me, she had multiple bruises on her body, as well as red, inflamed areas she hadn't had before. Who knows what the hell they do to them 😡😡? What do they expect? Naturally, a dog moves around a lot. It seems ignorant to me; I don't understand how people work in this field if they don't like animals or can't handle them—why the hell would you look for a job there? You pay for your pets to be cared for and treated well, not to have them handed back to you all bruised up. It’s a shame that a place with such a reputation treats pets this way; pets deserve respect, patience, and dignified treatment. I hope they take responsibility for what happened—it isn't right to pay for a service only for my dog ​​to come back injured. If this is how they treat animals when no one is watching, it is a very serious matter 😡.
I will give Nick and his business 100% in customer service, family oriented and the treat my baby amazing

I’ve been taking my dog here for years. It’s hard finding a good groomer you love & trust but they’re the best. My dog is always happy when I drop him off & the results are always perfect. The owners are so welcoming & they always accommodate me whenever I need any last minute appointments. 10/10!
I wouldn't trust anyone else with Cali

I am very disappointed with this grooming service. I have taken my dogs here several times for bathing and haircuts, but on multiple occasions they have been returned with uneven haircuts and dirty eyes with discharge. When I tried to address these issues and make a complaint, the staff seemed annoyed and upset instead of helping resolve the problem.

Customer service is poor, and the grooming quality has been consistently disappointing. I expect my dogs to be clean, well-groomed, and treated with care. Unfortunately, that has not been my experience. I would not recommend this place.

Mac Grooming Salon is the best! They always do an amazing job on my Shih Tzu’s haircut. She comes home smelling fresh and clean every time, and they give her the perfect round face shape that looks absolutely adorable. The staff is very caring and professional. My dog loves going there, and when I pick her up, she’s always happy and relaxed. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares about pets and does excellent work! 🐾💕
Clark has been our dog's groomer for over 8 years. We have large dogs and he is so good with them. Very gentle and kind. They always look beautiful. I highly recommend him.
Great grooming service

Mac is nice if you make An appointment make  sure you go to it and be on time
he means business
They are the best! Can't get any better. Very clean and there always very friendly always makes you feel at home.if I could give more than 5 stars I sure would. We love you nick and suzie the best!

I showed up for my scheduled appointment and was immediately disturbed by what I witnessed. A worker was handling a dog by holding it by the leash basically hanging the dog around its neck rather than properly walking it or supporting it. This is not only dangerous but a clear sign of negligence and poor animal handling. No pet owner should ever have to see their dog — or any dog — treated this way. I will not be returning and would strongly caution other pet owners
before trusting this facility with their animals.

Nick and his team are fantastic, Milo and I have been doing to him for over 10 years. He treats Milo like his own, the grooming prices are reasonable, and my dog always looks great. I’m really happy that I was able to work with him until our last grooming session. Even then, he and his team treated us with such care and compassion
Nick and his staff are such a wonderful team! Been coming here for years. Clean organized fast service. Highly recommend
This is the # 1 grooming service in queens. Im always satisfied with the service.

I took my puppy there to get groomed for the first time & they cut her ear inside and left it bleeding and didn’t tell us & then when we took her to the vet she had an ear infection. When we went to the place to let them know what they had did. The owner was yelling at cursing & attempted to hit my brother & threw things at him as he was leaving. If i could give them no stars i would because that is horrible & unprofessional.

I am beyond heartbroken and angry about what we experienced. We arrived a day early at 11:20 AM on Sunday 01/18/2026 and found our dog Zuko in an absolutely unacceptable condition. He was covered in poop and urine, visibly stressed, and had clearly been left like that for hours. The staff did not even offer to clean him. They handed him to us exactly like that until I demanded they wash him.

Another dog, my son Luis, was found standing in a huge puddle of urine, which tells me neither of them was properly walked or cared for that morning. That is basic care. This is not a small mistake. This is neglect.

Zuko is a rescue. We have worked so hard to make him feel safe, secure, and confident. Seeing him so scared that he came home, pooped in the hallway, and hid broke my heart. He has never done that before. He looked ashamed and terrified, and it honestly made me fear that he may have been yelled at or mistreated. No animal should ever leave a facility in that emotional state.

What makes this even worse is that no one called us. No one apologized. No one explained. No one even tried to make something up. Nothing. That silence speaks volumes. It felt like they didn’t care at all about the animals or their clients—only about money.

This is not just bad service. This is animal neglect. Possibly animal cruelty. I trusted this place with a life that depends on humans to protect him, and that trust was completely shattered.

If you love your pets, please think very carefully before leaving them here.
Excellent service!!!!
Staff are Friendly and my poodle love it here. Thank you for doing a great job.

I found Mr. Nico and Mac Dog during the pandemic when my other groomer was being very inconsistent in maintaining minimal business posture. I called, Nico was cordial and was happy to welcome Pharaoh, my 6lb yorkie who had been in despair as we waited for businesses to resume functioning.

The location is beautifully decorated with murals leading into the walkway and up the stairs. Along the staircase are all these beautiful photos of animals they've catered to. Outside of grooming services they have space off the right of the front desk that houses a day care and doggy hotel with the capacity to sleep 7-8 dogs on a reservation based system.

During drop off Mr. Nico asks me what I want for Pharaoh and is keen to deliver.

Basic grooming $60 and they leave with a cute little bandana.

Pharaoh has been with them for a year now and at least 6 times and I'm happy. He's never overjoyed about being left with anyone and this requires that he stays there for about 2 hrs on average. I check him for cuts, bruises etc before I leave and so far, he's good.
Going there for years. Always nice. Sometimes a challenge to schedule, but not a big deal.

I highly recommend this place!! Amazing! Great customer service, good communication and reminders, fair prices, beautiful and well kept location, clean, organized and smells great, cant believe is a grooming spot. Options to purchase doggy needs, the staff is welcoming and professional. They even had a xmas gift for my dog today. I found them on google and it has been great every visit. I have referred them to my loved ones. Give them a try, you wont regret it
Ive been a customer for more than 10yrs. I would recommend MACs to anyone and I have, they treat us like family.
Love them!

I discovered this pet grooming service just a few years ago for my parent’s dog. Their Shitzu always comes out perfectly groomed and smelling good. I love how neat they leave my parent’s pet.  We used take our pet to a different groomer and they i would notice cuts on her ears.

Here is why I like MACA DOG groomers. The owners are just amazing people, i have been to some places that you are not even greeted when you come in. The owners at MAC show concern to all pets, here is an amazing thing that happened and that most businesses  would take advantage of, I dropped off the dog and they told me it looks like she has fleas so i said ok.
I got a phone call and they told me, oh no she doesnt have fleas there is no charge. Any other place would have charged me for a service bot performed.

The place is very nice organized and clean. Love that they al sell pet clothing.

Called earlier yesterday with bo appointment and they made room for me, amazing service from the owner. I do recommend calling ahead as they get very busy.

Any concerns or questions make sure you let the owners know, they are people friendly and pet lovers

Highly recommended!
